# Federal Reserve H.4.1 fixture notice

`response.html` is a small, hand-selected HTML excerpt derived from the Board of
Governors of the Federal Reserve System's dated H.4.1 release for March 16,
2023. It retains five reported Wednesday values and the minimum table structure
needed to test the parser. It excludes site chrome, seals, logos, scripts,
styles, footnotes, and all unrelated rows.

The recording is machine-labeled `test_only_excerpt`. It is not the complete
official response, exact wire bytes, a source-signed artifact, or proof that
these exact bytes were available at any historical cutoff. Its self-reported
receipt time is not authenticated. OpenMacroState uses the current core replay
time for eligibility.

Source: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, H.4.1, Factors
Affecting Reserve Balances of Depository Institutions and Condition Statement
of F.R. Banks.

Dated source page:
<https://www.federalreserve.gov/releases/h41/20230316/h41.htm>

License classification:
`Federal-Reserve-Board-Public-Domain-Website-Information`

Terms: <https://www.federalreserve.gov/disclaimer.htm>

The Board's website disclaimer states that, unless otherwise indicated,
information on its website is in the public domain and may be copied and
distributed when the Board is cited as the source. This project decision applies
only to the Board-authored table and text excerpt in this fixture. It excludes
Federal Reserve seals, logos, trademarks, and third-party material. The excerpt
is not relicensed under Apache-2.0 or labeled CC0. OpenMacroState is not
affiliated with or endorsed by the Board.
